_about: How big each fish of the mod is (docs/SIZES.md). A fish rolls its size once, when it first appears, and keeps it. scale multiplies the fish's hitbox and model; weight is the chance against the others; wobble is the random spread round every scale (0.04 = plus or minus 4%). tiers gives a size tier weights of its own (tiny, small, medium, large, very_large, giant); the giant tier has no trophy, its share goes to large. Health is the tier's health x scale^1.5, rounded. Change a number and /reload; fish already in the world keep their size.
